verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that an account-based sign-in exists ("Log in to MyCIPO Patents"), and that trademark filing runs through online services. Nothing describes how that sign-in authenticates users. There is no mention of credential MFA, and nothing rules out biometric liveness, in-person identity proofing or a mailed PIN. Because the story's core claim (remotely completable credential MFA) is unevidenced for this applicable axis, the verdict is none.
